identity.title: ALMA Discovery of Dust Belts around Proxima Centauri

paper_type_evidence.quote: Here we report the ALMA detection of the star at 1.3 mm wavelength and the discovery of a belt of dust orbiting around it at distances ranging between 1 and 4 au, approximately.
